title: Game Analysis

descriptions.version: The Chess engine that will be analysing your moves.
descriptions.depth: The number of moves that the engine looks ahead when analysing moves.
descriptions.lines: The number of variations that the engine will consider. Must be at least 2 for some classifications.
descriptions.timeLimit: The maximum amount of time the engine is allowed to analyse a single move.

suggestionArrows.disabled: Disabled: Do not show engine arrows
suggestionArrows.continuation: Top Continuation: Show an arrow for the top move in this position
suggestionArrows.alternative: Top Alternative: Show an arrow for the top move in the previous position

engine.title: Engine
engine.linesWarning: At least 2 lines are required for Critical and some Brilliant moves.
engine.mobileSpeedNote: On phones, reviews with the 99 MB engine take about twice as long as with Lite, and each depth above 16 adds about 30-40% more time.
engine.mobileDepthNote: On phones, each depth above 16 adds about 30-40% more review time.
engine.mobileNativeSpeedNote: On phones, reviews with Stockfish 19 take about 4 times as long as with Lite, and each depth above 16 adds about 30-40% more time.

descriptions.simpleNotation: Show simple descriptions of Chess moves instead of standard notation. Example: Kxf4 -> King on e3 takes f4

exportVideo.title: Export Video
exportVideo.description: Make a video of the game, move by move, with every move's classification.
exportVideo.showPlayersDescription: Names and ratings above and below the board
exportVideo.showClocksDescription: Each player's time left after every move
exportVideo.noClocks: This game has no clock times
exportVideo.moveSoundsDescription: A sound as each move is played, as on the board
exportVideo.noSound: This device cannot add sound to videos, so it is silent.
exportVideo.boardOnly: Preview: only the board will be in the video
exportVideo.notSaved: The video is ready but was not saved.
exportVideo.saveFailed: The video is ready but could not be saved.
exportVideo.failed: The video could not be made.

shareReview.title: Share Review
shareReview.description: Send this code to anyone. They can open it with Import Reviewed Game to see the full review instantly, without analysing it again.

importReview.title: Import Reviewed Game
importReview.description: Paste a review code shared from OronChess to open the game already reviewed.
importReview.invalid: This is not a valid OronChess review code. Check that it was copied in full.

gameSearchMenu.noGamesFound: We couldn't find any games for this month.
